rationale: Arpan brings 14+ years of fintech engineering expertise and has built a 100+ person product engineering firm serving US and UK fintech clients, while Dahilon is founding Finlingo, a financial services startup, and studying data science with a focus on AI and finance. Arpan's deep conviction that AI is reshaping financial systems at a foundational level, combined with his hands-on experience in fintech API architecture and product strategy, directly complements Dahilon's early-stage fintech build and AI interests—making this a natural mentor-founder pairing where Arpan can advise on architectural decisions and product direction.
intro_message: Arpan Desai, meet Dahilon Mohammed — Dahilon is building Finlingo in San Francisco and would benefit from your 14+ years of fintech engineering and your conviction that AI is fundamentally reshaping financial systems.
